🔁 Repost von @GAKU_coc
How to sell Legend base subscriptions:
Make 10 tweaked bases. If just 1 defends against a pro, promote it like you’re a top builder and sell subscriptions.
I see this a lot lately. I feel bad for those falling for it. You’re better off copying a random player’s base.
